invariants.invariant: audit log is append-only; no UPDATE or DELETE on audit table
every mutating operation generates an audit log entry
update → updated_at and updated_by are set to current time and actor
actor.role >= endpoint.required_role
actor.role in endpoint.allowed_roles for mutating operations
resource.owner_id == actor.id for non-admin reads
concurrent reads and writes produce consistent results
lock acquisition order is consistent across transactions
optimistic lock version check prevents lost updates
balance >= 0 at all times (unless overdraft allowed)
each debit has a unique transaction_id and is processed exactly once
sum(before) == sum(after) for conserved quantity
api_response.data == db_select_result for the same entity
cache[key].data == db.record.data for cached entities
replication_lag < acceptable_threshold for read replicas
dependent events are processed in causal order
each message_id is processed at most once (or idempotently)
published_message_count == consumed_message_count over time window
approval.idempotency_key → at most one approval action
idempotency_key → exactly one created resource
payment_idempotency_key → at most one charge
price >= 0 and quantity >= 0 for non-refund operations
user input in response is HTML-entity-escaped
user input is parameterized; no raw SQL concatenation responds with injection pattern
cascade rules are explicit; no surprise deletion
entity can only archive when all dependent workflows are complete
only CANCELLED/EXPIRED entities can be physically deleted
entity.state.is_final → entity is immutable
state_history contains all mandatory intermediate states
target_state in current_state.allowed_next_states
data.tenant_id == actor.tenant_id for all reads
request.tenant_id is ignored; server uses token.tenant_id
write.target_tenant_id == actor.tenant_id
PII fields are masked according to policy in non-admin responses
fields_visible_to(role_a) ∩ fields_visible_to(role_b) == allowed_overlap
sensitive fields (password, token, ssn) NOT in any API response
